verification.summary: The enriched spec and ACCS align with the man-made breakpoints and the script has real assertions with hard timeouts, so it can pass or fail meaningfully. A few coverage gaps and a fragile parsing step are worth tightening but don't block implementation.

shouldFix.quote: read -r TOTAL1 OPEN_CNT1 CLOSED_CNT1 OPEN_LIST1 CLOSED_LIST1 <<< "$(parse_json "$HERE/first.json" | tr '\n' ' ')"
shouldFix.problem: If the open or closed list is empty, the space-joined fields shift and later assertions read the wrong values. Rare in a 15-issue seed but worth a null-guard.

shouldFix.quote: It shows Polling (CHANGED FROM Loading) with dots altering between . and .. and ...
shouldFix.problem: The 2026-09-09 requirement that the status bar sits below a blank-line separator from the issue list is never checked by accs.bash, so a tracker with no separation still passes.

shouldKnow.quote: closed issues required in seed dataset - at least 1
shouldKnow.problem: Only the seed's closed issue is guaranteed and checked; nothing forces the 5 dynamically-added issues to include a closed one, so the growth-phase active filter is only indirectly exercised via the same seed closed number.
